title: MCP Inspector tools/call via PowerShell
steps: Use the Inspector CLI entrypoint directly when launcher argument forwarding is ambiguous.
Place the stdio target command and its arguments before the -- delimiter.
Place Inspector options after the -- delimiter.
Provide PYTHONPATH to the child process with Inspector -e, not only in the parent PowerShell environment.
Run tools/list first, then tools/call, and require exit code 0 plus isError=false.
